options: I got turned around looking for the bathroom.
I thought I heard a window rattling up here.
The floorboards creaked—I was checking if something fell.
I'm an appraiser, I just wanted a quick look at the woodwork.
Your front door was unlocked and I heard a noise upstairs.
I dropped my keys earlier and thought they rolled up the stairs.
Just admiring the antique hallway, didn't mean to wander.
I thought I smelled smoke coming from the study.
My phone lost signal downstairs, I was trying to get a bar.
I saw a shadow move past the upstairs window from outside.
I'm looking for the fuse box—the downstairs lamp flickered.
Honestly, I thought this was the guest wing.
Sorry! Didn't mean to intrude—you have a stunning home.
My mistake completely. I'll head right back downstairs.
I was actually looking for you to thank you for your hospitality.
Please don't be alarmed, I'm leaving this room right now.
You startled me! I promise I wasn't touching anything.
I completely lost track of where I was—so sorry about that.
You've kept this place in incredible shape. I'll step back.
No harm meant at all. Hands up, I'm backing away.
I respect your privacy—I'll stick to the living room.
Forgive me, curiosity got the better of me. I'll go.
I didn't mean to invade your space, truly.
Let's start over—I'm heading straight back down the stairs.
Back off. I'll walk wherever I want.
Mind your own business if you know what's good for you.
Keep staring at me and we're going to have a problem.
Step aside before this gets ugly.
You don't want to test my patience tonight.
Stay out of my way and nobody gets hurt.
Drop the act. You know I'm not leaving empty-handed.
Don't take another step closer to me.
I'm not scared of you or this creepy house.
Move, or I'll move you myself.
You're in no position to give me orders.
Lower your voice before I lose my temper.

npc_lines.text: Oh, don't worry about it! Just mind the creaky floorboards.
You're polite, I'll give you that. Stick to the main hall, alright?
Easy mistake to make in the dark. The stairs are right behind you.
Everything okay? You seem a little jumpy.
Hmm. Alright, I'll take your word for it this time.
You shouldn't be wandering upstairs without asking.
Wait a second... why are you snooping around this room?
That excuse sounds rehearsed. What are you really looking for?
Hold on. Stay right where you are. Something about you doesn't add up.
I heard drawers opening up here. Empty your pockets.
You're sweating. People who aren't hiding anything don't sweat like that.
Keep your hands where I can see them. I'm watching you.
Don't take that tone with me in my own house.
You're pushing your luck, stranger. Step away before I make you.
Big mistake threatening me under my own roof.
One more word like that and you won't leave this hallway.
That's it! You've crossed the line!
I'm calling the police right now. Don't move a muscle.
Why do I keep finding you near our valuables?
You think we don't notice when things go missing?
Get downstairs. Now. Before I lose my patience.
I don't trust a single word coming out of your mouth.
Strange... I could have sworn I locked that door.
My patience is gone. You shouldn't have come here.

missing_item_comments: Wait... where is the {item}? It was right here a minute ago!
The {item} is gone! Someone has been up here!
Who touched the {item}?! Check the hallways!
No... the {item} is missing. That kid is still in the house!
npc_meetings_normal: Arthur: "That kid living with us is kind of suspicious..." | Eleanor: "I know. I keep hearing footsteps near the stairs."
Eleanor: "Did you lock the study?" | Arthur: "I thought I did. Keep your eyes open."
Arthur: "Something feels off tonight." | Eleanor: "Just don't let that guest out of your sight."
Eleanor: "Why is the house so quiet?" | Arthur: "Because someone is trying not to be heard."
npc_meetings_missing: Arthur: "If that kid stole our items, we are going to kill him." | Eleanor: "Agreed. Lock the doors."
Eleanor: "Our things are disappearing!" | Arthur: "Then nobody leaves this house alive tonight."
Arthur: "I've got the knife ready." | Eleanor: "Good. Find the little thief and end it."
Eleanor: "We shouldn't have let them stay here." | Arthur: "Don't worry. They won't make it to the woods."
